description: How one brand's advertising has moved: its daily active-ad trend, ads launched per week, how long its ads stay live (longevity buckets), and the technology stack on its site with when each tool was first seen. Use it for 'is this brand scaling up or pulling back' and 'what did they change'. The trend window and the launch and longevity charts depend on the plan. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

days.description: Trend window in days; defaults to 90. Capped by the plan.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_company_activity
title: Get brand activity
